hook: A three-star general jumps out of a plane.
narration: A three-star general just jumped out of a plane, strapped to a pararescueman.
Lieutenant General John Healy commands Air Force Reserve Command.
He came to Patrick Space Force Base in Florida to see how the 920th Rescue Wing gets ready to save lives.
In a tandem jump, the passenger is clipped to the front of an expert, who wears the parachute and makes every call.
Out the open ramp, high over the Florida coast.
A small drogue chute slows the fall, then the main canopy opens.
[short pause] Then the field came up fast.
outcome: He landed on his feet, and his first words were that it was awesome.
title: Three-star general's tandem skydive
description:
Lt. Gen. John P. Healy, commander of Air Force Reserve Command, made a tandem jump with pararescue Airmen from the 920th Rescue Wing at Patrick Space Force Base, Florida, on Oct. 17, 2023.

Footage: U.S. Air Force Reserve video by Staff Sgt. Matthew Matlock, Air Force Reserve Command, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/904341
